title: 計軸器列車占用偵測~Axle-counter train-occupancy detection
focus: 計軸事件守恆方向與資料有效性~Axle-count event conservation direction and data validity
summary: 本課聚焦計軸事件守恆方向與資料有效性。從區段軸數守恆建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把輪感測訊號品質與未知占用狀態保存連成可驗證的介面，最後以漏計試驗統計界限整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies axle-count event conservation direction and data validity. Start with axle conservation within a section to define physical or information boundaries, connect wheel-sensor signal quality with preserving unknown occupancy states as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through statistical bounds for missed counts. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對計軸事件守恆方向與資料有效性而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用雙感測點方向判別及回滾與拆編情境連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For axle-count event conservation direction and data validity, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through direction from paired sensing points and rollback and consist-change scenarios. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究區段軸數守恆。原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。敏感度只改 enter=48 至 49 axles，輸出變為 5 axles；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究雙感測點方向判別：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate axle conservation within a section. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. For sensitivity, change only enter=48 to 49 axles; the output becomes 5 axles. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate direction from paired sensing points: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 區段軸數守恆~Axle conservation within a section
units.title: 區段軸數守恆~Axle conservation within a section
units.mechanism: 本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。差值為零仍需邊界感測器、方向判斷與狀態可信度成立；未知或故障狀態不能僅因兩個數字相等就自動宣告清空。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。~Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement. A zero difference is useful only when boundary sensing, direction and state validity are trustworthy. Unknown or failed states cannot be declared clear merely because two numbers match. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure.
units.verify: 以標記輪對的玩具車雙向重播，對照人工真值、事件順序與感測器有效旗標。以「區段軸數守恆」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Replay a marked model vehicle in both directions and compare manual truth, event ordering and sensor-validity flags. For axle conservation within a section, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 漏計與多計可能互相抵消形成假零值，方向錯誤則會讓計數增減的符號顛倒。回到「區段軸數守恆」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Missed and extra counts can cancel into a false zero, while direction errors reverse the signs of increments. Trace the input chain for axle conservation within a section. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車~Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.
units.practice: 只把進入軸數 enter 從 48 改成 49 axles（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4 變為 5 axles。先說明「區段軸數守恆」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only entering axles enter from 48 to 49 axles (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 4 to 5 axles. Explain the causal direction for axle conservation within a section, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 雙感測點方向判別~Direction from paired sensing points
units.title: 雙感測點方向判別~Direction from paired sensing points
units.mechanism: 本單元利用同一輪對通過兩個感測點的先後順序，特別檢查低速回滾時的事件配對。兩個相鄰感測點的事件先後順序可提供方向，間距除以時間差可估局部速度。時間解析度與輪緣幾何都影響結果；接近停車或往返擺動時，事件配對比公式本身更容易出錯。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。~Use the order in which one wheelset passes two sensing points, paying particular attention to event pairing during slow rollback. Event ordering across two nearby sensors provides direction, while separation divided by transit time estimates local speed. Timing resolution and wheel geometry affect the estimate. Near standstill or during oscillatory movement, pairing the correct events is often harder than evaluating the equation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected.
units.verify: 使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。以「雙感測點方向判別」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests. For direction from paired sensing points, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 將不同輪對的脈衝配成一對會產生不合理速度，反向回滾也會破壞單純遞增事件假設。回到「雙感測點方向判別」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Pairing pulses from different wheelsets produces implausible speed; rollback violates assumptions of monotonically ordered events. Trace the input chain for direction from paired sensing points. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度~Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
units.practice: 只把通過時間差 dt 從 0.015 改成 0.0165 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變為 18.1818 m/s。先說明「雙感測點方向判別」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only passage time difference dt from 0.015 to 0.0165 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 20 to 18.1818 m/s. Explain the causal direction for direction from paired sensing points, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 輪脈衝時間解析度~Temporal resolution of wheel pulses
units.title: 輪脈衝時間解析度~Temporal resolution of wheel pulses
units.mechanism: 本單元比較不同通過速度的脈衝寬度與取樣間隔，判斷資料列數是否足以保留事件邊界。固定時間取樣在移動系統中對應空間間隔，速度越高相同頻率越容易漏過狹窄特徵。時間戳抖動會讓空間取樣不均勻；提高取樣率仍需足夠感測頻寬與抗混疊處理，不能只增加資料列數。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速與等時間取樣的間距，不代表可以解析同樣大小的最小缺陷。~Compare pulse width and sampling interval at different passage speeds, assessing whether the samples preserve the event boundaries. Time sampling in a moving system corresponds to spatial spacing; at higher speed, the same rate can miss narrow features. Timestamp jitter makes spatial samples nonuniform. A higher rate still requires adequate sensor bandwidth and anti-alias filtering, rather than merely more rows of data. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Spacing for constant speed and uniform sampling; it is not automatically the smallest resolvable defect size.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：移動速度 v=25 m/s；取樣頻率 f=20 Hz。公式 y=v/f，代入得 y=1.25 m/sample。邊界：等速與等時間取樣的間距，不代表可以解析同樣大小的最小缺陷。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: motion speed v=25 m/s; sampling frequency f=20 Hz. Formula y=v/f gives y=1.25 m/sample. Boundary: Spacing for constant speed and uniform sampling; it is not automatically the smallest resolvable defect size.
units.verify: 對已知長度特徵以不同速度重播，檢查事件是否保留並比較位置內插誤差。以「輪脈衝時間解析度」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Replay a known-length feature at different speeds, check event retention, and compare position-interpolation error. For temporal resolution of wheel pulses, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 高頻振動混疊成低頻漂移可能被誤判為幾何偏差，遺失時間戳也會破壞空間重建。回到「輪脈衝時間解析度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~High-frequency vibration can alias into apparent low-frequency geometry drift; missing timestamps also corrupt spatial reconstruction. Trace the input chain for temporal resolution of wheel pulses. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同~Fixed sampling frequency gives identical spatial resolution at every speed.
units.practice: 只把移動速度 v 從 25 改成 27.5 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.25 變為 1.375 m/sample。先說明「輪脈衝時間解析度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only motion speed v from 25 to 27.5 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.25 to 1.375 m/sample. Explain the causal direction for temporal resolution of wheel pulses, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 輪感測訊號品質~Wheel-sensor signal quality
units.title: 輪感測訊號品質~Wheel-sensor signal quality
units.mechanism: 本單元將金屬輪對訊號與外部干擾分開量測，使用相同頻寬比較訊雜比而不設定現場門檻。以相同阻抗下的電壓比換算訊雜比時使用二十倍對數。訊號與雜訊必須採一致頻寬與有效值定義；只把量測頻寬縮小可能讓數字改善，卻同時刪掉辨識狀態所需的訊息。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：相同阻抗與相同頻寬的均方根電壓，不適用任意峰值比。~Measure wheel-related signal and external interference separately, comparing signal quality at equal bandwidth without prescribing field thresholds. Voltage-ratio signal-to-noise uses twenty times the logarithm when impedances match. Signal and noise must share bandwidth and RMS definitions. Narrowing measurement bandwidth can improve the number while removing information needed to distinguish states. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: RMS voltages with equal impedance and bandwidth; arbitrary peak ratios are not interchangeable.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：訊號有效值 signal=2 V_rms；雜訊有效值 noise=0.1 V_rms。公式 y=20*log10(signal/noise)，代入得 y=26.0206 dB。邊界：相同阻抗與相同頻寬的均方根電壓，不適用任意峰值比。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: signal RMS signal=2 V_rms; noise RMS noise=0.1 V_rms. Formula y=20*log10(signal/noise) gives y=26.0206 dB. Boundary: RMS voltages with equal impedance and bandwidth; arbitrary peak ratios are not interchangeable.
units.verify: 將有訊號與無訊號樣本採同一濾波器處理，保留頻譜與時間波形交叉比對。以「輪感測訊號品質」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Process signal-present and signal-absent samples through the same filter, retaining both spectra and time traces. For wheel-sensor signal quality, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 電磁干擾若落在訊號頻帶內，總有效值可能變大但辨識反而變差；飽和也會破壞比例。回到「輪感測訊號品質」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~In-band interference may increase total RMS while worsening identification; saturation also destroys the assumed proportionality. Trace the input chain for wheel-sensor signal quality. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 總量測電壓越大就能保證訊號品質越好~A larger measured total voltage guarantees better signal quality.
units.practice: 只把雜訊有效值 noise 從 0.1 改成 0.11 V_rms（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 26.0206 變為 25.1927 dB。先說明「輪感測訊號品質」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only noise RMS noise from 0.1 to 0.11 V_rms (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 26.0206 to 25.1927 dB. Explain the causal direction for wheel-sensor signal quality, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 計軸事件排序~Ordering axle-count events
units.title: 計軸事件排序~Ordering axle-count events
units.mechanism: 本單元追蹤分散感測點的時間偏差，檢查資料延後抵達時是否仍能保留原始事件順序。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Track clock offsets among distributed sensing points, checking whether original event order survives delayed message arrival. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.verify: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「計軸事件排序」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For ordering axle-count events, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「計軸事件排序」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for ordering axle-count events. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致~Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
units.practice: 只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「計軸事件排序」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for ordering axle-count events, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 計數訊息遺失分析~Loss of count-event messages
units.title: 計數訊息遺失分析~Loss of count-event messages
units.mechanism: 本單元區分事件沒有產生與事件產生後傳送遺失，透過源端紀錄和接收端紀錄交叉比對。獨立封包遺失可以相乘得到連續遺失機率，但實際無線遮蔽常造成成串遺失。增加重送次數會占用時間與頻寬，不能把可靠度與時效分開最佳化；舊封包即使最後送達，也可能已不適合當前控制。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：明確假設各次遺失獨立同分布，不適用遮蔽引起的相關失聯。~Distinguish an event that was never generated from one lost after generation by comparing source-side and receiver-side records. Independent packet losses multiply to give a consecutive-loss probability, but radio obstruction often causes correlated bursts. Retransmissions consume time and bandwidth, so reliability and freshness cannot be optimized independently. A packet eventually delivered may already be too old for the current control decision. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Losses are explicitly independent and identically distributed; correlated outages are outside the model.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立遺失率 p=0.02 1；連續封包數 n=3 packets。公式 y=p**n，代入得 y=8e-06 1。邊界：明確假設各次遺失獨立同分布，不適用遮蔽引起的相關失聯。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent loss probability p=0.02 1; consecutive packet count n=3 packets. Formula y=p**n gives y=8e-06 1. Boundary: Losses are explicitly independent and identically distributed; correlated outages are outside the model.
units.verify: 同時統計單包遺失率與最長連續遺失段，將結果和獨立模型比較以辨識相關性。以「計數訊息遺失分析」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure single-packet loss and the longest loss burst together, then compare them with the independent model to identify correlation. For loss of count-event messages, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把成串失聯當成獨立事件會嚴重低估尾端風險，時間戳重排也可能讓重送掩蓋陳舊資料。回到「計數訊息遺失分析」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Treating burst outages as independent events understates tail risk; reordered timestamps may also hide stale retransmissions. Trace the input chain for loss of count-event messages. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只知道平均丟包率就能完全判定通訊可靠性~The mean packet-loss rate completely determines communication reliability.
units.practice: 只把獨立遺失率 p 從 0.02 改成 0.022 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 8e-06 變為 1.0648e-05 1。先說明「計數訊息遺失分析」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only independent loss probability p from 0.02 to 0.022 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 8e-06 to 1.0648e-05 1. Explain the causal direction for loss of count-event messages, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 未知占用狀態保存~Preserving unknown occupancy states
units.title: 未知占用狀態保存~Preserving unknown occupancy states
units.mechanism: 本單元把計數值和有效旗標分開建模，當資料不完整時保留未知而不默認區段清空。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Model count values separately from validity flags, retaining an unknown state when data is incomplete rather than defaulting to a clear section. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.verify: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「未知占用狀態保存」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states. For preserving unknown occupancy states, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「未知占用狀態保存」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for preserving unknown occupancy states. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合~Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
units.practice: 只把布林變數數量 bits 從 8 改成 9 bits（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 256 變為 512 states。先說明「未知占用狀態保存」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only number of Boolean state variables bits from 8 to 9 bits (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 256 to 512 states. Explain the causal direction for preserving unknown occupancy states, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 計軸感測共同原因~Common causes in axle sensing
units.title: 計軸感測共同原因~Common causes in axle sensing
units.mechanism: 本單元檢查兩個感測通道是否受同一安裝位移或電磁環境影響，避免把相關輸入當獨立證據。兩支路都失效才失去功能的架構可降低獨立故障貢獻，卻不能消除共同原因。共同電源、相同軟體缺陷或同處淹水會同時影響兩支路；因此增加硬體數量不能取代分離、異質性與失效偵測的證據。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。~Examine whether two sensing channels share installation movement or electromagnetic exposure, avoiding treatment of correlated inputs as independent evidence. A function lost only when both branches fail can reduce independent contributions but cannot eliminate common causes. Shared power, identical software defects or flooding at one location can affect both branches. More hardware does not replace evidence for separation, diversity and fault detection. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。公式 y=common+(1-common)*p*p，代入得 y=0.000104 1。邊界：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. Formula y=common+(1-common)*p*p gives y=0.000104 1. Boundary: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
units.verify: 把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。以「計軸感測共同原因」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces. For common causes in axle sensing, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。回到「計軸感測共同原因」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Trace the input chain for common causes in axle sensing. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障~Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
units.practice: 只把共同原因事件機率 common 從 0.0001 改成 0.00011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.000104 變為 0.000114 1。先說明「計軸感測共同原因」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only common-cause event probability common from 0.0001 to 0.00011 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.000104 to 0.000114 1. Explain the causal direction for common causes in axle sensing, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 回滾與拆編情境~Rollback and consist-change scenarios
units.title: 回滾與拆編情境~Rollback and consist-change scenarios
units.mechanism: 本單元用離線事件序列覆蓋停住、反向與車組改變，逐項核對需求而不提供營運重置程序。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Use offline event sequences for stopping, reversal and consist changes, checking requirements without providing an operational reset procedure. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「回滾與拆編情境」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For rollback and consist-change scenarios, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「回滾與拆編情境」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for rollback and consist-change scenarios. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險~One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
units.practice: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「回滾與拆編情境」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for rollback and consist-change scenarios, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 漏計試驗統計界限~Statistical bounds for missed counts
units.title: 漏計試驗統計界限~Statistical bounds for missed counts
units.mechanism: 本單元將輪對測試紀錄按速度與輪型分層，說明單一條件下零漏計不能證明所有條件無誤。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Stratify wheelset trials by speed and wheel type, explaining why zero missed counts in one condition cannot establish error-free behaviour everywhere. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.verify: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「漏計試驗統計界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For statistical bounds for missed counts, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「漏計試驗統計界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for statistical bounds for missed counts. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零~Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
units.practice: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「漏計試驗統計界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for statistical bounds for missed counts, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

facts: 教學假設：區段軸數守恆採 enter=48 axles；本課公式結果 4 axles，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for axle conservation within a section: enter=48 axles; this model gives 4 axles, not a field rating.
教學假設：雙感測點方向判別採 spacing=0.3 m；本課公式結果 20 m/s，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for direction from paired sensing points: spacing=0.3 m; this model gives 20 m/s, not a field rating.
教學假設：輪脈衝時間解析度採 v=25 m/s；本課公式結果 1.25 m/sample，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for temporal resolution of wheel pulses: v=25 m/s; this model gives 1.25 m/sample, not a field rating.
教學假設：輪感測訊號品質採 signal=2 V_rms；本課公式結果 26.0206 dB，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for wheel-sensor signal quality: signal=2 V_rms; this model gives 26.0206 dB, not a field rating.
教學假設：計軸事件排序採 drift=20 ppm；本課公式結果 0.072 s，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for ordering axle-count events: drift=20 ppm; this model gives 0.072 s, not a field rating.
教學假設：計數訊息遺失分析採 p=0.02 1；本課公式結果 8e-06 1，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for loss of count-event messages: p=0.02 1; this model gives 8e-06 1, not a field rating.
